page_review.title: Door With Doorframe
page_review.author: Theocritus
page_review.description: A simple door with a door frame.
page_review.noai_notice: The page bars use of this model in datasets for, in development of, or as input to generative AI programs.
page_review.visible_geometry: One wood leaf with two recessed panels, surrounding frame and black lever handle; source dimensions, separability and original handedness are not verified.

local_payloads.format_note: Size suggests the converted 4K GLB option; the file does not identify its download option.
local_payloads.embedded_images: Nine JPEG/PNG images in GLB buffer views; no external URIs.

local_payloads.archive_entries: scene.usdc and twelve embedded texture files, including files named Poliigon_MetalSteelBrushed_7174_2K.

dependency_observation: GLB materials include names Poliigon_WoodVeneerOak_7760_4K and Poliigon_MetalSteelBrushed_7174_2K. Those names and the USDZ texture paths indicate possible third-party texture dependencies; this does not by itself prove their licensing chain.

local_derivative.method: Retain the source GLB geometry buffer and first four geometry buffer views byte-for-byte. Remove all nine source images and their buffer views, textures and samplers. Replace six material definitions with locally authored flat PBR colors; preserve mesh primitives, nodes, accessors and geometry. No source texture pixels enter the selected payload.

decision_basis: NoAI concerns programs designed to generate new content; B1 policies output control actions. Original textured downloads have unverified Poliigon-named dependencies and are not selected for B1. The local selected derivative preserves the source door geometry while removing every embedded image and texture reference; its materials are independently authored. Any future generative-content use or reuse of original textures needs separate rights review.
